metadata.scenario: A member expresses concerns over discrepancies in billing for their last few sessions. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Betty Lou Smith. I wanted to discuss some billing discrepancies I've noticed in my account. Of course, Betty. I'm here to help. What specific discrepancies are you seeing? Well, I noticed that the charges for my last three sessions seem higher than usual. I thought my rate was fixed. I understand your concern. Let me pull up your account to take a closer look. Okay, I see you’ve been with us for 10 months now. Your sessions for fall prevention and mobility assistance typically range between $28 and $35 per hour. Yes, that’s what I thought too, but the last few sessions charged me $40 an hour! That’s quite a jump. I see why that would be frustrating. Let me verify the exact dates and services billed during those sessions. Could you give me a moment? I’ll check your last few invoices. Sure, take your time. Thank you for your patience. It looks like the higher charges were due to a service adjustment for additional care provided during your last visits. I see, but I wasn't informed about any changes, and I wasn’t expecting that. I apologize for the lack of communication. I will certainly address that to ensure it doesn’t happen again. Thank you, I appreciate that. Can we also check if my usual caregiver is still scheduled for next week? Yes, let me confirm that for you. Your usual caregiver is scheduled for Monday and Thursday next week. Is that still good for you? Yes, that works perfectly. Great! Now, regarding your billing, I can create a billing dispute for those charges. Would you like me to do that? Yes, please. I think I should get an explanation for those charges. I’ll ensure our billing department reviews it and gets back to you within the next few days. Thank you, I appreciate your help. You're welcome, Betty. Also, if you ever want to discuss additional services, our physical therapy sessions could really help with fall prevention. That’s something I might consider. Perfect, I’ll have Lisa, our Care Coordinator, reach out to you with more information. That sounds good. Thank you for taking the time to clarify everything for me. No problem at all! Thank you for your continued trust in CareFirst, Betty. Have a great day! You too, Margaret. Goodbye! Goodbye!
